title: Te Reo o te Whakaaro Nui i roto i ngā Atarangi
intro: He tangata nō ngā rā onamata, e mōhiotia ana mō tōna māramatanga hohonu, e kōrero ana ki a koe puta noa i ngā rautau. Kāore tēnei tangata i kī he poropiti ia, engari i rere te whakaaro nui i roto i ā rātou kupu. He mātua i waiho i tētahi taonga tuku iho mutunga kore o te ārahi, kei te tiakina tonutia ā rātou tohutohu i roto i ngā ngākau o te miriona, e whakahuatia ana, e whakaaroarohia ana tae noa mai ki tēnei rā.
clues: I whiwhi ahau i tētahi taonga atua i wehewehe i ahau - he whakaaro nui hōhonu rawa, ā, i noho koia hei āhuatanga matua mōku puta noa i te hītori.
Ehara ahau i te karere, ehara hoki i te anahera - he wairua noa iho i manaakitia ki te māramatanga hōhonu me te māramatanga ki te ao.
Ko taku hononga tino piri ko taku tamaiti, ā, nā tēnei hononga i tukuna taku karere pumau rawa atu.
I akiaki ahau i te whakawhetai ki te Mea nāna nei i homai ngā mea katoa ki ahau, me te whakatūpato hoki kia kaua e whakapehapeha, e whakakake.
I whakaako ahau i te taumaha o ngā mahi ahakoa he rite ki te purapura sinapi, me te hiranga o te whakaiti i te reo me te whakaiti.
Kei roto i te Quran tōku ingoa, ā, kei reira tonu aku kupu tohutohu ki taku tama aroha e tiakina ana mō ake tonu atu.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Lukmana te Whakaaro Nui
Dhul-Kifl te Kaiwhakatapu
Khidr te Kaihaerere Poto
Ko Harut te Anahera i Papurona
Ko Marut te Anahera i Pāpera

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whakamātautau i te manawanui mā te mate
Te tuku whakaaro nui me te tohutohu i tā te tamaiti
Te maka ki roto i te ahi nui
Ka hikitia oratia ki te rangi
Te hanga i tētahi waka nui hei mawhiti i te whakangaromanga
trial.answer: Te tuku whakaaro nui me te tohutohu i tā te tamaiti

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He whare karakia tapu
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
Ngā kupu whakaaro nui mutunga kore e tukua ana ki tā te tama
He torona karaihe whakahīhī
He māra kua taupokina e te ururua
location.answer: Ngā kupu whakaaro nui mutunga kore e tukua ana ki tā te tama

outcome.label: Hua
options: I homai te whakaaro nui, ā, i whakahau i te whakawhetai ki a Allah
I noho hei rangatira mō ngā jinn, ngā tāngata, me te hau
I tangohia oratia ki te rangi
I horomia e te tohorā nui, ā, i puta mai kua whakahoutia
Makaia ki roto i te poka e ngā tuakana hae
outcome.answer: I homai te whakaaro nui, ā, i whakahau i te whakawhetai ki a Allah

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
